title: JoyAI-Image: Official ComfyUI Nodes and Spatial Editing Model
summary: A multimodal foundation model from JD.com that combines an 8B understanding model with a 16B MMDiT for precise image editing. It specializes in spatial reasoning tasks such as object rotation, camera perspective control, and high-fidelity content modification.
research_notes: The architecture uses a closed-loop system where the understanding model informs the generation process to reduce hallucinations during complex spatial transformations.

evolution.summary: Following its April 2026 release, the project quickly added official ComfyUI support and achieved a milestone in May 2026 with full integration into the Hugging Face Diffusers library. Community contributors have since released GGUF and FP8 quantized versions to make the 30GB+ model accessible on consumer GPUs.
